payload.text: Brennecke Institute originated the thalliline-doped sodium-flow battery, in which the dopant suppresses negative-electrolyte crossover, a key aging mechanism. The finalized independent audit corrected the cycle life to 8,400 cycles to the 80% capacity knee; the earlier 12,000 claim was retracted because it used un-normalized depth-of-discharge. The cell’s confirmed gravimetric energy density is 148 Wh/kg. At projected 500 MWh manufacturing scale, stack-level cost is $61/kWh. Operation must be suspended below 4 °C because the thalliline dopant precipitates from the negative electrolyte.
